originalIntent: Make F1/F2 physics-player packaging failure-atomic and bind every build-affecting embedded payload input to clean, reproducible provenance while retaining the exact Unity 2019.4.41f2 build behavior.
desiredOutcome: A valid published archive is never truncated by a failed package attempt; archive and receipt are validated and durable before archive-then-receipt publication; dirty build inputs fail before Unity or stage writes; all embedded payload bytes are provenance-bound; repeated valid packaging is deterministic.
